name: Pets Going To Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that the soul of every living thing is in God's hand, affirming His sovereign care over both man and beast (Job 12:10). While God’s righteousness preserves both humans and animals (Psalms 36:6), the Bible also teaches that certain matters remain secret and are left to the Lord’s wisdom (Deuteronomy 29:29). The righteous show compassion to their animals (Proverbs 12:10), yet the ultimate destiny of pets is not explicitly revealed, reminding believers to trust in God's perfect justice and mercy (Ecclesiastes 3:16; Psalms 36:5).
